svg.title: One feature, start to finish
svg.desc: Seven steps animate in order: settle the plan, write the spec, slice tickets, build, review, an optional independent second opinion, and a verified result. Each step names the skill that does it and the artifact it leaves behind.

svg.text: Each step leaves something you can read. Skip any step the task does not need.
